name: ovos-persona-server
description: A single HTTP server that exposes one or more OVOS `Persona`s as **eight concurrent API surfaces** — so any LLM client (OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Ollama tools, Anthropic SDK, Google Gemini SDK, Cohere SDK, HuggingFace TGI client, AWS Bedrock client, or any A2A agent) can talk to your OVOS persona without changes.
author: OpenVoiceOS

setup_notes.heading: Persona Config Examples
Installing the MCP extra
setup_notes.content:
pip install ovos-persona-server[mcp]

Without the `[mcp]` extra, or without passing `--mcp`, only the UTCP endpoints are active.
